name: crl-language-support
description: CRL + CEL keyword highlighting, live validation diagnostics, CRL→CQL + CEL→FHIR-JSON emit, and catalog-driven authoring help (completion + hover) for .crl / .cel Markdown files.

commands.title: CRL: Set up tools (MCP, CLAUDE.md, highlighting)
CRL: Refresh project cache (re-scan all .crl files)
CRL: Open Raw Source at Locus
CRL: Set Navigator Primary Pane (Source / CRL / CEL)

crl.autoProvision.description: Automatically configure CRL tools (MCP server + CLAUDE.md) and highlighting when a workspace containing .crl files is opened. Use the 'CRL: Set up tools' / 'CRL: Remove tools' commands to do it manually.

crl.cockpit.primary.description: The Knowledge Engineering default primary pane — which pane the navigator walks. 'source' lists source units; 'crl' lists CRL decision nodes; 'cel' lists CEL cases. Set per-window; switch live with 'CRL: Set Navigator Primary Pane'.

crl.cockpit.paneOrder.description: Left-to-right column order of the Knowledge Engineering panes. 'source', 'crl', and 'cel' are always shown; 'tree' (the graphical decision-tree flowchart) is shown by default but can be removed from this list to hide it. Set it in User settings to persist across all projects, or in Workspace settings for one project. A malformed list is repaired automatically. Changes apply live to open panes.

crl.cockpit.showKeys.description: Show the at-rest correspondence key (a per-unit number + cycled color) on each corresponding element across the Knowledge Engineering CRL / CEL panes and the navigator, so 'what links to what' is visible without selecting. Toggle live with 'CRL: Toggle Correspondence Keys'.

crl.cockpit.failedCriteriaMode.description: Which failed criteria Knowledge Engineering highlights when a failing CEL case is selected. 'blocking' (default): only the criteria that blocked the expected disposition (empty for a passing case). 'all': every evaluated-unsatisfied 'when' in the run. Toggle live with the segmented control on the Knowledge Engineering Tree pane. SHARED with the Medical Validation panel.

crl.cockpit.showDetails.description: Medical Validation only: show why the selected case got its outcome — highlight the deciding criteria (the ones that, by being false, routed it there, e.g. the age gate for a not-adult denial) across the Source / Tree / CRL panes. Off by default. Toggle live with the Details control on the Tree pane.

crl.medical-validation.primary.description: The Medical Validation panel's default primary pane — which list the navigator walks. 'cel' (default) navigates the scenario cases (surfaced in the Worklist, and in the read-only CEL pane if opened); 'source' lists source units. Set per-window; switch live with 'CRL: Set Navigator Primary Pane'.

crl.medical-validation.paneOrder.description: Left-to-right column order of the Medical Validation panel's panes. 'worklist' (the review surface — verdicts + notes), 'source', 'tree', and 'questionnaire' (the read-only path questionnaire for the selected case) are shown by default; 'crl' and 'cel' (the read-only case list) can be added. 'worklist' and 'cel' are now SEPARATE panes, so listing both opens both. Set it in User settings to persist across all projects, or in Workspace settings for one project. A malformed list is repaired automatically. Changes apply live to open panes.

crl.medical-validation.showKeys.description: Show the at-rest correspondence key (a per-unit number + cycled color) on each corresponding element across the Medical Validation panel's panes and the navigator, so 'what links to what' is visible without selecting. Toggle live with 'CRL: Toggle Correspondence Keys'.

crl.issueBaseUrl.markdownDescription: The issue-tracker **collection** URL that a review flag's `; ref #N` resolves into — e.g. `https://github.com/owner/repo/issues`. In Medical Validation, a flag with a numeric ref shows an **Open issue #N** action that opens `<base>/N`. Must be an `http`/`https` URL with no credentials, query, or fragment. A value set in **workspace** settings applies only in a [trusted workspace](command:workbench.action.manageTrust); set it in **user** settings to use it everywhere. Leave empty to disable the link-out.

crl.agent.provider.markdownDescription: Which model backend the CRL editor agent uses. `vscode-lm` (default) reuses the language models contributed by the **GitHub Copilot Chat** extension — zero setup, prompts stay within your VS Code language-model provider. `anthropic` sends prompts directly to **Anthropic's API** (`api.anthropic.com`) and requires an API key — run 'CRL: Set Anthropic API Key' or set the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` environment variable. There is no automatic fallback between the two.

crl.agent.anthropicModel.description: The Anthropic model id the agent requests. Used only when crl.agent.provider is 'anthropic'.
